sn17.5:1.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave piḷhakā gūthādī gūthapurā puṇṇā gūthassa || pūrato cassa mahā gūthapuñjo || || 4
sn17.5:1.5: Ahaṃ hi gūthādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa || pūrato ca myāyam mahā gūthapuñjo ti || || 5
sn17.5:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati ||
sn17.5:1.7: So tattha bhuttāvī ca hoti yāvad attho nimantito ca svātanāya || piṇḍapāto cassa pūro || || 6
sn17.5:1.8: So ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhugaṇassa majjhe vikatthati
sn17.5:1.9: Bhuttāvī camhi yāvad attho nimantito camhi svātanāya || piṇḍapāto ca myāyam pūro || lābhī camhi cīvara-piṇḍapātasenāsana-gilānapaccaya-bhesajja-parikkhārānaṃ || || Ime pana aññe bhikkhū appapuññā appesakkhā na lābhino cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccaya bhesajjaparikkhārānanti || || 7
sn17.5:1.10: So tena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto aññe pesale bhikkhū atimaññati || ||
sn17.5:1.11: Tañhi tassa bhikkhave moghapurisassa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya || || 8
sn17.5:1.12: Evaṃ dāruno kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko || pe|| || 9
